skill.name: social-playbook-skill
skill.description: Design complete social media playbooks with campaign goals, content ideas, scripts, thumbnails, captions, platform mappings, and posting cadence for multi-platform campaigns.
skill.summary: Generate structured social media campaign playbooks for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Shorts, and Reels.
skill.author: CleanExpo

content.value_statement: Planning content across many platforms can create inconsistent messages and duplicated work. This skill turns campaign goals into structured playbooks with scripts, captions, visuals, and posting cadence.
actual_capabilities: Creates campaign overviews with goals, personas, target platforms, and positioning.
Generates 10 to 30 video or post concepts with hooks and script outlines.
Maps each idea into YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook formats.
Suggests thumbnail concepts, text overlays, captions, and visual directions.
Builds weekly posting maps with recommended time windows.
Structures playbook outputs for later database insertion or operational handoff.
limitations: It does not publish posts or connect to social media accounts.
It does not verify platform trend data or live audience analytics.
It depends on accurate brand, offer, and audience context from the user.
It produces planning content, not final edited videos or image assets.

use_cases.title: Plan a launch campaign
use_cases.description: Turn a new product or feature announcement into platform-specific videos, captions, thumbnails, and posting cadence.

use_cases.title: Create client onboarding content
use_cases.description: Build a first-month content plan for a new client using their audience, offer, tone, and platform priorities.

use_cases.title: Build a reusable content library
use_cases.description: Generate a bank of hooks, scripts, visuals, and post mappings for recurring educational or authority content.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic campaign playbook
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete first draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a social media playbook for [business]. The goal is [goal]. The audience is [audience]. Focus on [platforms]. Include ideas, hooks, scripts, captions, thumbnails, and cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt one idea across platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Take this content idea: [idea]. Turn it into a YouTube long video, YouTube Short, TikTok, Instagram Reel, carousel, LinkedIn post, and Facebook post. Keep the brand tone [tone].

prompt_templates.title: Build a month of posts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for scheduling and volume.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-week social playbook for [client]. Include 20 content ideas, weekly themes, platform mappings, script outlines, caption angles, and recommended posting windows.

prompt_templates.title: Design an execution-ready content system
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an execution-ready social playbook for [client] using these offers, personas, and proof points: [context]. Include campaign structure, content pillars, platform variants, asset requirements, storage fields, and production notes.

output_examples.input: Create a launch playbook for a trade software feature aimed at small contractors.
output: Campaign overview with lead generation as the primary goal.
Twenty content ideas covering pain points, feature benefits, objections, and proof points.
Platform mappings for long video, Shorts, TikTok, Reels, carousel, LinkedIn, and Facebook.
Thumbnail concepts, caption angles, and a weekly posting map.

output_examples.input: Repurpose a customer success story into social content.
output: A short hook focused on the before-and-after result.
A 90-second script outline for video platforms.
A LinkedIn post version with a clear business lesson.
Suggested B-roll ideas and text overlay options.

output_examples.input: Build a content library for an agency with no visual ideas.
output: Content pillars for education, trust, proof, and offer awareness.
Thirty reusable post concepts with audience pain points.
Visual style notes for thumbnails, overlays, transitions, and screen recordings.
A structured handoff format for campaign execution.

best_practices: Provide the offer, audience, brand tone, and platform priorities before asking for the playbook.
Review generated scripts for claims, pricing, and compliance before production.
Use the playbook as a planning brief, then adapt captions and visuals to current platform context.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic viral ideas without giving audience and offer context.
Do not publish generated claims without checking accuracy and approvals.
Do not use one platform format unchanged across every social channel.

faq.question: Does this skill publish social media posts?
faq.answer: No. It creates planning materials, scripts, captions, and schedules for a team or tool to execute.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports planning for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Reels, and carousels.

faq.question: Can it create finished video files?
faq.answer: No. It suggests scripts, visuals, thumbnails, and production notes, but it does not render final media assets.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the business, offer, target audience, campaign goal, brand tone, platforms, and any existing proof points.

faq.question: Can teams use it for client onboarding?
faq.answer: Yes. It is well suited for creating initial campaign plans and reusable content libraries for new clients.

faq.question: Does it use live analytics or trend data?
faq.answer: No. It does not fetch live platform analytics. Add current data manually if it should guide the plan.
